A tiger doesn’t just hunt with its eyes.

It hunts with your fear.

Animals detect human stress hormones. And the moment they sense your panic, they know you are prey.

Vivek Awasthi has spent years inside India’s forests. He has survived elephant charges, been chased by a leopard and found a 7-month-old tiger cub inside his own resort.

And in this conversation, he shared what India’s forests are really like.

The rules of the wild are not what you think.

And then there is India’s Wildlife Mafia.

Just yesterday, five baby orangutans were found abandoned in Odisha’s Balasore forest. A billion dollar criminal network. Running right here. Right now.

This episode will change how you see every jungle forever.
